info.name: HR Resume Retrieval - Phase-wise Verification
info.description: Verifies every phase of 02_Resume_Retrieval_Phasewise_Implementation.md (Phases 1-18). Start the server with npm run dev (http://localhost:3000). Run the folders in order: Phase 5 saves the resume ids that Phases 11 and 12 use.

item.name: Phase 1 - Retrieval Readiness Check
item.description: GET /v1/search/readiness. Ready only when stored resumes have mistral-embed 1024-d embeddings.

item.name: Phase 2 - Retrieval Module Scaffold
item.description: Retrieval runs in the same server as ingestion; ingestion endpoints still work.

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("No file uploaded. Send a PDF in form-data field 'file'"));

item.name: Retrieval route served by the same server
Phase 3 - Shared Query Embedding Endpoint
item.description: POST /v1/embeddings with the same Mistral EmbeddingService used by ingestion.

item.name: Phase 4 - Resume Repository
item.description: Read-only queries on the resumes collection. There is no endpoint for this phase; the repository is exercised by the BM25 and vector requests in Phases 5 and 6, and by npm test.

item.name: Phase 5 - Atlas Search / BM25
item.description: POST /v1/search/bm25 on the resume_bm25 index (rawText, skills, jobTitles, experienceSummary, role, company). No LLM call.

item.name: BM25 search (saves resume ids for Phases 11-12)

exec: pm.test('sorted by score', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.score).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].score)));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("topK must be an integer between 1 and 100"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("filters.minYearsExperience must be a non-negative number"));

item.name: Phase 6 - MongoDB Vector Search
item.description: POST /v1/search/vector: query embedding, then Atlas Vector Search on resume_vector (cosine). Optional exactRescore re-scores the top K exactly.

exec: pm.test('sorted by vectorScore', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.vectorScore).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].vectorScore)));
pm.test('sorted by vectorScore', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.vectorScore).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].vectorScore)));

item.name: Vector search with filter and exact re-score

exec: pm.test('sorted by vectorScore', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.vectorScore).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].vectorScore)));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("exactRescore must be true or false"));

item.name: Phase 7 - SearchService BM25 + Vector Methods
item.description: bm25Search() and vectorSearch() return one normalized candidate shape. No endpoint of its own: the BM25 and vector endpoints (Phases 5-6) use these methods, and npm test checks the shape.

item.name: Phase 8 - Hybrid Search
item.description: POST /v1/search/hybrid: BM25 and vector run in parallel; both lists are returned separately with timings. Scores are not merged.

exec: pm.test('some resumes appear in both lists', () => pm.expect(d.vector.some(r => bm25Ids.has(r.resumeId))).to.be.true);

item.name: Phase 9 - Merge + Deduplicate Candidates
item.description: One candidate pool, deduplicated by resumeId, keeping sources. Checked through the final search response.

item.name: Final results have no duplicate resumes and keep sources

exec: pm.test('no duplicate resumeIds', () => pm.expect(new Set(r.map(x => x.resumeId)).size).to.eql(r.length));
pm.test('sources are bm25 and/or vector', () => r.forEach(x => { pm.expect(x.sources).to.not.be.empty; x.sources.forEach(s => pm.expect(['bm25', 'vector']).to.include(s)); }));

item.name: Phase 10 - Groq LLM Service
item.description: rerankCandidates(), summarizeCandidateFit() and extractMetadata() on openai/gpt-oss-120b, with GROQ_API_KEY_FALLBACK when the first key is rate-limited. No endpoint of its own: Phases 11 and 12 expose it, and npm test checks the output validation.

item.name: Phase 11 - LLM Re-Ranking Endpoint
item.description: POST /v1/search/rerank. Run Phase 5 first. Returned ids must be a subset of the input.

exec: pm.test('ids are a subset of the input', () => d.results.forEach(r => pm.expect(input).to.include(r.resumeId)));
pm.test('scores 0-1 with a reason', () => d.results.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.relevanceScore).to.be.within(0, 1); pm.expect(r.reason).to.be.a('string'); }));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("candidates must be a non-empty array"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("candidates must not repeat a resumeId"));

item.name: Phase 12 - Candidate Summarization
item.description: POST /v1/search/summarize. Grounded only in the supplied candidate data. Run Phase 5 first.

item.name: maxTokens out of range is rejected

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("maxTokens must be an integer between 20 and 1000"));

item.name: Phase 13 - Full End-to-End Search Service
item.description: endToEndSearch(): validate, embed, BM25 + vector in parallel, merge, deduplicate, top N, LLM re-rank, optional summaries.

exec: pm.test('summaries unless degraded', () => d.degraded || d.results.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.summary).to.be.a('string')));

item.name: Phase 14 - Final Search Endpoint
item.description: POST /v1/search with the doc's example request.

item.name: Phase 15 - Fallback Logic
item.description: Re-rank failure -> BM25 then vector order (LLM_RERANK_FAILED); vector failure -> BM25 only (vectorFallback); BM25 failure -> vector only (bm25Fallback); summary failure -> results without summaries (SUMMARIZATION_FAILED); both fail -> 503 SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE. Failures cannot be forced from Postman; npm test (tests/unit/fallbacks.test.ts) covers every path. These requests check the fields on a healthy response.

exec: pm.test('warnings only use documented codes', () => d.warnings.forEach(w => pm.expect(['LLM_RERANK_FAILED', 'SUMMARIZATION_FAILED']).to.include(w)));

item.name: Phase 16 - Logging + Timings
item.description: Request ids (X-Request-Id) and one JSON log line per request with componentTimings; check the npm run dev console.

item.name: Phase 17 - Payload + Validation Controls
item.description: Limits: query 1000 chars, topK 100, rerankTopN 20, finalTopK <= rerankTopN, 50 re-rank candidates, snippet 2000 chars, maxTokens 20-1000, JSON body 100kb (413 above).

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Search query must be at most 1000 characters"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("topK must be an integer between 1 and 100"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("options.finalTopK must not be greater than options.rerankTopN"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("options.rerankTopN must be an integer between 1 and 20"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("filters.minYearsExperience must be a non-negative number"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Request body is not valid JSON"));

item.name: Phase 18 - Automated Tests
item.description:
Run in a terminal, not Postman:
- npm test: 35 unit tests (deduplication, candidate mapping, filter validation, BM25/vector normalization, LLM output validation, Groq key fallback, fallback ordering).
- npm run test:integration: 10 tests against the real API, MongoDB, Mistral and Groq for every retrieval endpoint, including end-to-end search.
